Every field of the five copybooks (43 rows: elementary fields, the two group keys and the fillers) mapped to
a column of schema `carddemo`. Row ids are `<copybook>/<field>`; tickets cite them. Offsets start at 0 and lengths are
in bytes, as in the stream manifest.

## Encoding rules

| Rule | Applies to | Reading a record | Writing a record |
|---|---|---|---|
| E1 | PIC 9(n) - unsigned zoned decimal, USAGE DISPLAY | n digit characters (EBCDIC X'F0'-X'F9'; in the fixture files the characters 0-9). Anything else rejects the record. | zero-padded to n digits |
| E2 | PIC S9(n)V99 - signed zoned decimal, sign in the last byte (trailing overpunch, no SIGN SEPARATE) | last byte carries digit and sign: X'C0'-X'C9' ({ A-I) positive, X'D0'-X'D9' (} J-R) negative, X'F0'-X'F9' accepted as positive; V is an implied decimal point, two places | always C for zero or positive and D for negative (what the golden files hold). An F-signed source digit therefore comes back as C (G02); minus zero comes back as plus zero (G03) |
| E3 | PIC X(n) - text | host: EBCDIC code page to be confirmed (G01), fixtures: ISO-8859-1. Stored as CHAR(n), so trailing spaces are kept by padding and ignored in comparisons, as in COBOL. A byte that is not a character of the code page (for example X'00') rejects the record (G07) | padded with spaces to n bytes in the output code page |
| E4 | FILLER | kept as the n raw bytes in a BYTEA column, no translation | written back byte for byte; for a new interest transaction the filler is n spaces in the output code page (G05) |
| E5 | COMP-3 (packed) and COMP (binary) | none of the 43 fields of the five copybooks is COMP-3 or COMP; every field is USAGE DISPLAY. The only binary item the program sees is PARM-LENGTH S9(04) COMP in its LINKAGE SECTION, which is not on any dataset | not needed. The codec must refuse a copybook field whose USAGE is not DISPLAY instead of guessing |
| E6 | Key order | VSAM returns TCATBALF in the byte order of the EBCDIC key. The target reads ORDER BY trancat_acct_id, trancat_type_cd COLLATE "C", trancat_cd | equal for all-digit or all-letter type codes; differs when letters and digits are mixed, because EBCDIC sorts letters before digits (G06) |

In the fixture files the same bytes appear as ISO-8859-1 characters: `{` and `A`-`I` end a positive amount, `}` and `J`-`R` a negative one (`0000010000{` is +1000.00 as S9(09)V99).

Columns with no copybook field:

## `carddemo.interest_run` (no copybook)

| Column | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | `BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY` | one row per run |
| `parm_date` | `CHAR(10) NOT NULL` | the PARM of INTCALC.STEP15 (INT-Q02) |
| `started_at / finished_at` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | wall clock of the target run (not the legacy run clock) |
| `status` | `VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL` | LOADED, CALCULATED, EXPORTED, FAILED or ABANDONED |
| `loaded_* / written_* counts and sums` | `BIGINT / NUMERIC(18,2)` | the reconciliation figures of strategy items RC1-RC6 |

## Keys and alternate indexes

| Table | Legacy key | Primary key | Legacy alternate index | Index |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `carddemo.account` | KSDS KEYS(11 0) - ACCT-ID (app/jcl/ACCTFILE.jcl:36) | `acct_id` | none defined for this file | - |
| `carddemo.card_xref` | KSDS KEYS(16 0) - XREF-CARD-NUM (app/jcl/XREFFILE.jcl:39) | `xref_card_num` | alternate index KEYS(11,25) NONUNIQUEKEY UPGRADE on XREF-ACCT-ID, reached through path CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH (app/jcl/XREFFILE.jcl:72-92) | card_xref_acct_ix ON (xref_acct_id, xref_card_num) - not unique |
| `carddemo.tran_cat_balance` | KSDS KEYS(17 0) - TRAN-CAT-KEY (app/jcl/TCATBALF.jcl:36) | `trancat_acct_id, trancat_type_cd, trancat_cd` | none | - |
| `carddemo.disclosure_group` | KSDS KEYS(16 0) - DIS-GROUP-KEY (app/jcl/DISCGRP.jcl:36) | `dis_acct_group_id, dis_tran_type_cd, dis_tran_cat_cd` | none | - |
| `carddemo.interest_transaction` | none - SYSTRAN is a sequential file in write order (app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:37-41) | `run_id, seq_no` | downstream only: TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS KEYS(16 0) on TRAN-ID and alternate index KEYS(26 304) on TRAN-PROC-TS (app/jcl/TRANFILE.jcl:53, :84); both belong to COMBTRAN's target file, not to this stream | UNIQUE (run_id, tran_id) |
| `carddemo.interest_run` | none | `run_id` | none | - |

No foreign key is declared between the replica tables: the legacy files have none, and a balance whose account or rate is missing must reach the job so that it stops as CBACT04C does (INT-R08).

## Mapping gaps that could not be closed (12)

| Gap | What is not known | Detail | Affects | Who can close it | What closes it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| G01 | Host code page is not stated | No CCSID is in the JCL, the copybooks or the scheduler export. The parity tool assumes cp037 for EBCDIC. Needed to decode every PIC X field and the brace and letter sign bytes. | all five layouts | mainframe data owner | a statement of the CCSID, or a hex dump of one record per file |
| G02 | Sign of positive zoned numbers on the host | The golden files hold C-signed positives. Host data written by other programs or loaded by IDCAMS may hold F-signed (unsigned) digits. The value is the same, the byte is not, so a re-encoded record can differ by one byte per amount. | every S9 field (8 fields) | mainframe data owner | the compile options (NUMPROC) and a sample of production records |
| G03 | Minus zero | A zoned field can hold -0 (X'D0' in the last byte). NUMERIC has no minus zero; it is written back as +0. | every S9 field | mainframe data owner | trial-load profile: count of -0 values (expected 0) |
| G04 | Dates kept as text | ACCT-OPEN-DATE, ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE and ACCT-REISSUE-DATE are PIC X(10). The fixtures hold YYYY-MM-DD, but nothing in the stream reads them, so their content on the host is unverified. They stay CHAR(10) so that no record is rejected or changed. | CVACT01Y, 3 fields | data owner | trial-load profile of the three fields; then a decision whether to type them as DATE |
| G05 | Bytes the program never sets in an interest transaction | TRAN-DESC is filled by STRING, which does not pad, and the 20-byte FILLER is never moved to. Off-host both hold spaces. On the host they hold whatever working storage held at program start (INT-T04). The target writes spaces. | CVTRA05Y TRAN-DESC (bytes 25-100) and FILLER | mainframe application owner | one SYSTRAN generation from the host in hex |
| G06 | Key order of mixed type codes | EBCDIC sorts letters before digits, the C collation sorts digits before letters. If one account has type codes of both kinds, the target reads its balances in a different order and the six-digit transaction counter is handed out differently. | CVTRA01Y TRANCAT-TYPE-CD | data owner | trial-load profile: distinct TRANCAT-TYPE-CD values (fixtures: digits only) |
| G07 | Text fields with bytes that are not characters | A PIC X field holding low-values or packed data cannot be stored in CHAR. The loader rejects the record and the trial load fails; it does not substitute a character. | every PIC X field (20 fields) | data owner | trial-load reject count (expected 0) or a rule per field |
| G08 | Accounts with more than one card | The alternate index on XREF-ACCT-ID is not unique. Which record CBACT04C gets, or whether it stops with status 02, is not determined by the source (INT-H03). The target stops the run (policy switch multiCard = STOP) until the register row is answered. | CVACT03Y XREF-ACCT-ID | business owner | INT-H03 answered; trial-load profile: number of accounts with several cards |
| G09 | Category code is numeric here and CHAR(4) in the Db2 tables | TRANCAT-CD, DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD and TRAN-CAT-CD are PIC 9(04) and map to NUMERIC(4,0). carddemo.transaction_type_categor.trc_type_category is CHAR(4) (db/postgres/01-transaction-type.sql). No foreign key is defined between them; the legacy files have none either. | CVTRA01Y, CVTRA02Y, CVTRA05Y category code | data architect | a decision on one type for the category code across the schema |
| G10 | Timestamps kept as text | TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS are PIC X(26) in the form YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000, which is not a PostgreSQL timestamp literal. They stay CHAR(26) so the exported record is exact. | CVTRA05Y, 2 fields | data architect | a decision when the transaction history itself moves |
| G11 | Volumes are unknown | The estate holds no record counts for the production files. Chunk size, load time and whether the whole job fits the window between CLOSEFIL and OPENFIL cannot be sized. | all tables | mainframe operations owner | LISTCAT record counts of the four input files and the run time of INTCALC |
| G12 | Which DD serves the read by account id | CBACT04C reads XREF-FILE by its alternate key but never names DD XREFFIL1; the edge is a candidate (manifest D3, ask A5). The target reads card_xref through card_xref_acct_ix either way. | CVACT03Y | mainframe application owner | stream ask A5 |
